 Ja Morant Leaves Blazers-Grizzlies Game with Hamstring Injury
 A star goes down in Portland.
 by Dave Deckard Oct 30, 2026, 4:19 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Portland Trail Blazers have announced that guard Ja Morant will not return to the team’s game versus the Memphis Grizzlies due to a hamstring injury. Morant played 23 minutes before heading to the locker room. The team relayed later that Morant was out.
 If updates come tonight, they’ll be here or in our game recaps.
